purpose: Executable simulation-to-public-record transfer and calibration denominator for preventing synthetic-to-real, simulator-to-observation, or digital-twin transfer from becoming prediction or candidate-native support.

sim_to_real_transfer_rows.source_domain: Simulator, emulator, synthetic-data population, benchmark environment, computational experiment, theory-space scan, detector simulation, survey mock, or metadata-only source domain.
sim_to_real_transfer_rows.target_domain: Public laboratory, catalog, map, waveform, survey likelihood, detector trigger, benchmark holdout, observed-sector target, or route-local real-world calibration set.
sim_to_real_transfer_rows.transfer_or_calibration_protocol: Declare calibration data, domain-gap model, discrepancy term, nuisance adaptation, uncertainty propagation, coverage test, posterior calibration, out-of-domain guard, and rollback trigger before spending sim-to-real language.
sim_to_real_transfer_rows.residual_gap: Sim-to-real transfer can be calibrated for one target while failing under new apparatus, survey window, simulator misspecification, latent nuisance, rare event, or candidate-distinguishing residual.
sim_to_real_transfer_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer real-world validation, prediction, or candidate-native support from simulation, emulator, or synthetic data without explicit transfer control.
